e.title: **一个人群、逐年滚动，所以跨文件对得上**：`synthmed`——**生成符合 ResDAC 传输规范（FTS）的合成 Medicare 理赔数据**（**MEDPAR／MBSF**），**输出是**定宽 DAT 文件**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它维持**单一内部受益人队列并逐年前推**，**因此**人口学特征、ID、地点与诊断史在各文件之间保持一致**；**⭐ 并**故意注入**真实数据质量问题**（**种族错编、**出生日期漂移、**与州相关的空 ID**）；**⭐ 每个作者标出**自己做了哪一部分****（**Zenodo DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22648509`，v0.2.0，Apache-2.0**）
e.title_en: One cohort rolled forward year by year, so the files agree across years: synthmed generates synthetic Medicare claims data conforming to a set of ResDAC file transfer specification schemas, emitting fixed-width DAT files, and it maintains a single internal cohort of synthetic beneficiaries which it rolls forward one year at a time so that demographics, identifiers, locations and diagnosis histories stay consistent across files, while deliberately injecting realistic data-quality errors such as race miscoding, date-of-birth drift and state-correlated null identifiers, with each author credited for the specific part they built.
e.title_hk: **一個人群、逐年滾動，所以跨檔案對得上**：`synthmed`——**生成符合 ResDAC 傳輸規範（FTS）的合成 Medicare 理賠資料**（**MEDPAR／MBSF**），**輸出是**定寬 DAT 檔**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它維持**單一內部受益人隊列並逐年前推**，**因此**人口學特徵、ID、地點與診斷史在各檔案之間保持一致**；**⭐ 並**故意注入**真實資料品質問題**（**種族錯編、**出生日期漂移、**與州相關的空 ID**）；**⭐ 每個作者標出**自己做了哪一部分****（**Zenodo DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22648509`，v0.2.0，Apache-2.0**）
e.summary: **synthetic-resdac-claims（`synthmed`）**（**Zenodo 记录** `22648509`；GitHub 仓库 `ForomePlatform/synthetic-resdac-claims`）**是一个 Python 包**，**逐字自述为**「**a Python package that generates synthetic ResDAC / Medicare claims data (MEDPAR, MBSF) as fixed-width DAT files that conform to a set of ResDAC File Transfer Specification (FTS) schemas**」。**本条目属于本轮主题**「存证」**，**它在**可引用性**与**内部一致性**两端都给了样本**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 单一队列、逐年前推**——**逐字**「**The generator maintains a single internal cohort of synthetic beneficiaries and rolls it forward year-by-year so that demographics, IDs, locations and diagnosis histories stay consistent across files.**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它**故意**注入数据质量问题**——**逐字**「**Realistic data-quality errors (race miscoding, date-of-birth drift, state-correlated null IDs) are injected on the way through.**」**——**⭐ 即**「**可用的合成数据**」不是「**干净的数据**」**，**而是**带着真实缺陷的数据****；**⭐⭐ ③ 作者分工逐条写明**（**含**「**original design and prototype implementation**」、「**HMO / Buy-In enrollment indicator sampler (sticky Markov-chain model)**」、「**packaging, refactor into a Python library, and input data provenance**」**，**且**四人都带 ORCID 与单位**）；**⭐⭐ ④ 引用机制是可机读的**——`CITATION.cff`（**2,943 字节**，CFF 1.2.0**）**逐字含**「**GitHub renders a "Cite this repository" button in the right sidebar when this file is present at the repo root.**」**，**并在** `identifiers` **里指向同伴的 Zenodo 数据 DOI**；**⭐⭐ ⑤ 版本被钉住**——**Zenodo 的关联标识逐字为** `https://github.com/ForomePlatform/synthetic-resdac-claims/tree/v0.2.0`（**关系** `isSupplementTo`**）**。**⚠️ 本次未安装、未生成任何数据、未读定宽格式的规范细节**。
e.summary_hk: **synthetic-resdac-claims（`synthmed`）**（**Zenodo 記錄** `22648509`；GitHub 倉庫 `ForomePlatform/synthetic-resdac-claims`）**是一個 Python 套件**，**逐字自述為**「**a Python package that generates synthetic ResDAC / Medicare claims data (MEDPAR, MBSF) as fixed-width DAT files that conform to a set of ResDAC File Transfer Specification (FTS) schemas**」。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「存證」**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 單一隊列、逐年前推**——**逐字**「**maintains a single internal cohort of synthetic beneficiaries and rolls it forward year-by-year so that demographics, IDs, locations and diagnosis histories stay consistent across files**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它**故意**注入資料品質問題**——**逐字**「**Realistic data-quality errors (race miscoding, date-of-birth drift, state-correlated null IDs) are injected on the way through.**」**；**⭐⭐ ③ 作者分工逐條寫明**（**含**「**original design and prototype implementation**」「**packaging, refactor into a Python library, and input data provenance**」**，**四人皆附 ORCID 與單位**）**；**⭐⭐ ④ 引用機制可機讀**（`CITATION.cff`，CFF 1.2.0**）**；**⭐⭐ ⑤ 版本被釘住**（**關聯標識逐字為** `https://github.com/ForomePlatform/synthetic-resdac-claims/tree/v0.2.0`**）**。**⚠️ 本次未安裝、未生成任何資料**。
e.summary_en: The project synthetic-resdac-claims, also called synthmed, archived on Zenodo and hosted on GitHub, **is a Python package that generates synthetic Medicare claims data as fixed-width DAT files conforming to a set of national data-archive file transfer specification schemas**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of evidence and citability, and it provides a sample at both ends**: it maintains a single internal cohort of synthetic beneficiaries and rolls it forward year by year so that demographics, identifiers, locations and diagnosis histories stay consistent across files; **it deliberately injects realistic data-quality errors on the way through, naming race miscoding, date-of-birth drift and state-correlated null identifiers**, which means usable synthetic data here is not clean data but data carrying realistic defects; **each of the four authors is credited for the specific part they built**, from the original design and prototype through an enrolment indicator sampler described as a sticky Markov-chain model, to packaging and the refactor into a library and responsibility for input data provenance, with every author carrying an ORCID; the citation mechanism is machine-readable, with a citation file that notes GitHub will render a cite-this-repository button when the file sits at the repository root, and whose identifiers point at a companion dataset DOI; and the archived version is pinned, since the Zenodo related identifier points at a version-tagged GitHub path. **Nothing was installed, no data was generated, and the fixed-width specification was not read this round.**
e.body:
**synthetic-resdac-claims**（**包名** `synthmed`；**GitHub 仓库** `ForomePlatform/synthetic-resdac-claims`；**Zenodo 记录** `22648509`）**是一个生成**合成 Medicare（美国联邦医疗保险）理赔数据**的 Python 包**，**逐字自述为**「**a Python package that generates synthetic ResDAC / Medicare claims data (MEDPAR, MBSF) as fixed-width DAT files that conform to a set of ResDAC File Transfer Specification (FTS) schemas**」。**本次实测**：**Zenodo 记录** —— **DOI 逐字为** `10.5281/zenodo.22648509`**、概念 DOI 为** `10.5281/zenodo.22648508`**、**版本** `v0.2.0`**、**类型** Software**、**许可** Apache-2.0**、**创建与更新均为 2026-09-07**、**1 个文件**（**逐字名为** `ForomePlatform/synthetic-resdac-claims-v0.2.0.zip`**）**、**访问权限** open**；**四位作者均附 ORCID**（**`Belakurski, Pavel`、`Chumack, Mark`、`Etin, Dmitry`、`Bouzinier, Michael`**）**；**关键字逐字为** `medicare`、`resdac`、`synthetic-data`、`claims`、`medpar`、`mbsf`**；**关联标识逐字为** `https://github.com/ForomePlatform/synthetic-resdac-claims/tree/v0.2.0`（**关系** `isSupplementTo`**）**；**GitHub 仓库** —— **创建 2026-05-16、最后推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**语言 Python**；**文件实测**：`README.md` 14,142 字节、`CITATION.cff` 2,943 字节、`LICENSE` 11,357 字节（**Apache-2.0**）**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「**存证：编号、版本、许可，以及把每个数追回它的来源**」**。

**可核实信息（均 README、`CITATION.cff` 与 Zenodo 元数据实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它维持**单一队列并逐年前推**，**故跨文件的一致性是被设计出来的****——**README 逐字**：**「**The generator maintains a single internal cohort of synthetic beneficiaries and rolls it forward year-by-year so that demographics, IDs, locations and diagnosis histories stay consistent across files. Realistic data-quality errors (race miscoding, date-of-birth drift, state-correlated null IDs) are injected on the way through.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮值得抄的一处**：**生成**多年、多文件**的合成数据时，**最容易被忽略的是「**同一个人在不同年份的文件里是不是同一个人**」——**⭐ 这里的解法不是事后对齐，而是**一开始就只有一个人群**（**single internal cohort**），**逐年前推时**人口学与诊断史**随之演化**；**⭐ 而更值得记的是它**故意**往里加错**：**「**合成数据**」的目的不是「**干净**」，**而是「**能在上面测方法、**包括测出错处理**」——**种族错编、**出生日期漂移、**与州相关的空 ID**三样**都是**真实数据里会遇到的具体缺陷**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它按**规范**输出，而不是按自己的方便**——**逐字说明输出为**「**fixed-width DAT files that conform to a set of ResDAC File Transfer Specification (FTS) schemas**」，**关键字另逐字含** `medpar` **与** `mbsf`（**两类 Medicare 数据文件**）**；**⭐ 即**生成器要服从**别人定的布局**（**定宽、**字段位置固定**）**，**而不是输出一张通用表格**——**⭐ 这与本站第 349 轮记下的「**格式即契约**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ③ 作者分工被逐条写明，**且每人附 ORCID 与单位****——**README 的 Authors 一节逐字为**：**`Pavel Belakurski`**（**Northwestern University**）——**「**original design and prototype implementation**」**，**并逐字指向原型仓库** `ChilliPenguin/SynthMed`；**`Mark Chumack`**（**University of Massachusetts Amherst**）——**「**HMO / Buy-In enrollment indicator sampler (sticky Markov-chain model)**」**；**`Dmitry Etin`**（**Deggendorf Institute of Technology**）；**`Michael Bouzinier`**（**Harvard University**）——**「**packaging, refactor into a Python library, and input data provenance**」**。**⭐ 即**「**谁做了什么**」**写在 README 正面**，**且**最后一人的职责里**明确包含**输入数据的出处**（**input data provenance**）**——**⭐ 这与本词条项目自身的纪律**同向**。**⭐⭐ ④ 引用机制是可机读的，而且指向两份不同的东西****——`CITATION.cff`（**2,943 字节**）**内容逐字含**：**版本行** `cff-version: 1.2.0`；**注释逐字**「**GitHub renders a "Cite this repository" button in the right sidebar when this file is present at the repo root.**」；**类型** `type: software`；**作者四项**（**各含** `family-names`／`given-names`／`orcid`，**两人另含** `alias` **与** `affiliation`**）**；**`message` 逐字为**「**If you use this software in academic work, please cite it using the metadata below. The companion synthetic dataset is archived on Zenodo at the DOI given under `identifiers`.**」**；**⭐ README 的 Citation 一节另给出一条**与代码不同的**引用**——**一位作者 2026 年的**数据集**条目**（**逐字标题**「**Synthetic Medicare-Like Inpatient Claims and Beneficiary Data Conforming to ResDAC FTS Layouts**」**）**，**DOI 逐字为** `10.5281/zenodo.18915558`**。**⭐ 即**「**引用这个软件**」与「**引用这份数据**」**是两个不同的条目、**两个 DOI**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮四条里**登记分层**做得最清楚的一处**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 版本被钉在具体标签上**——**Zenodo 的关联标识不是指向仓库首页，而是逐字指向** `.../tree/v0.2.0`**；**⭐ 即**「**这一版存档对应的是哪一次提交**」**是可核对的**（**读者可从 Zenodo 一步走到该标签**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 状态被如实标注**——**README 的 Status 一节逐字开头为**「**Alpha — functional and exercised end-to-end at production scale**」——**⭐ 即**它同时说清了两件事：**成熟度是**Alpha**，**而**使用程度是**在生产规模上端到端跑过****（**⭐ 本词条如实指出：这两者并不矛盾，但都不等于**经过第三方验证****）**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]] 记录的是**官方发布的去标识化样本**，**[[insurance-datasets-synthetic]]、[[gen-syn]]、[[synthpop]]、[[sdv]]、[[ctgan-r]]、[[africa-synth-insurance-datasets]] 覆盖**合成数据生成**的不同做法**，**[[hcc-python]]、[[icd-hcc-mappings]]、[[medicare-claims-pricer]]、[[cms-open-data]] 覆盖**Medicare 侧的数据与编码**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**按官方**定宽传输规范**生成、**并**自带真实缺陷**的合成理赔数据**」这一形态**；**⭐ 并如实指出**：**其**合成**性质意味着**不能**用它推断真实的美国医疗费用或人群特征**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]]、[[gen-syn]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「**在没有真数据时怎么造一份能用、且知道它哪里脏的数据**」这一问题的样本**；**⭐ 其中三点可以直接照抄**：**① 一开始就只维护一个人群，**别事后对齐**；**② 故意注入**具名的缺陷类型**，**而不是造一份过分干净的假数据**；**③ 把**软件引用**与**数据引用**分成两个 DOI**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有安装该包、没有生成任何数据、没有读任何 DAT 文件**，**故不主张**其生成器按所述工作、不主张其输出真的符合 ResDAC 的 FTS 规范、**也不主张那些注入的错误类型与真实数据中的分布相似**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何源码**——**本次只读了** `README.md`（14,142 字节）、`CITATION.cff`（2,943 字节）、**Zenodo 元数据与文件清单**，**故不主张**「**单一年度队列**」的实际实现、`sticky Markov-chain** 的具体做法、以及**错误注入的比例与机制**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核对 ResDAC FTS 规范本身**（**未访问 ResDAC 任何页面**），**故不主张其「**符合规范**」这一说法**——**⭐ 本词条只记录「**它自述符合**」**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实 README 中那条**同伴数据集 DOI**（`10.5281/zenodo.18915558`）**的内容**（**未打开该记录**）**，**也未核实它与本软件包的版本关系**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**「**生产规模端到端跑过**」这一说法**（**无证据、**无第三方验证**）**；**⚠️ ★0、**无外部引用记录**，**均不构成质量证据，**也不构成反证**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实四位作者与其单位的关系**（**只读到 README 自述与 ORCID**）**；**未核实原型仓库** `ChilliPenguin/SynthMed` **是否与其有代码继承关系**。**⑦ ⚠️ 许可为 Apache-2.0**（**Zenodo 字段与仓库 `LICENSE` 一致**），**未读许可正文**；**⭐ 但本词条如实指出**：**「**合成数据**」**本身**可能另有条款**（**本次未见单独的数据许可声明**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ Zenodo 记录创建 2026-09-07 与仓库推送 2026-09-10 都在解冻窗口之内**，**故本条不需要窗口例外**；**⭐ 但本词条如实指出**：**「**按官方定宽规范生成、**维持单一人群跨年一致、**并故意注入具名数据缺陷、**且软件与数据分开引用**」这一组合，此前池内没有对应物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**合成数据**不得用于推断真实的医疗费用、**患病率或人群差异**。
e.body_hk:
**synthetic-resdac-claims**（**套件名** `synthmed`；**GitHub 倉庫** `ForomePlatform/synthetic-resdac-claims`；**Zenodo 記錄** `22648509`）**是一個生成**合成 Medicare（美國聯邦醫療保險）理賠資料**的 Python 套件**。**本次實測**：**Zenodo 記錄** —— **DOI 逐字為** `10.5281/zenodo.22648509`**、概念 DOI 為** `10.5281/zenodo.22648508`**、**版本** `v0.2.0`**、**類型** Software**、**許可** Apache-2.0**、**建立與更新均為 2026-09-07**、**1 個檔案**、**四位作者均附 ORCID**；**關鍵字逐字為** `medicare`、`resdac`、`synthetic-data`、`claims`、`medpar`、`mbsf`；**關聯標識逐字為** `https://github.com/ForomePlatform/synthetic-resdac-claims/tree/v0.2.0`（`isSupplementTo`**）**；**GitHub 倉庫** —— **建立 2026-05-16、最後推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**Python**；**檔案實測**：`README.md` 14,142 位元組、`CITATION.cff` 2,943 位元組、`LICENSE` 11,357 位元組**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「**存證**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 README、`CITATION.cff` 與 Zenodo 元數據實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它維持**單一隊列並逐年前推**，**故跨檔案的一致性是被設計出來的****——**逐字**：**「**The generator maintains a single internal cohort of synthetic beneficiaries and rolls it forward year-by-year so that demographics, IDs, locations and diagnosis histories stay consistent across files. Realistic data-quality errors (race miscoding, date-of-birth drift, state-correlated null IDs) are injected on the way through.**」**。**⭐ 即**最容易被忽略的是「**同一個人在不同年份的檔案裡是不是同一個人**」，**而解法不是事後對齊，**而是一開始就只有一個人群**；**⭐ 更值得記的是它**故意**加錯**——**「**合成資料**」的目的不是「**乾淨**」，**而是「**能在上面測方法、**包括測出錯處理**」。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它按**規範**輸出**（**逐字**「**fixed-width DAT files that conform to a set of ResDAC File Transfer Specification (FTS) schemas**」**）**；**⭐ 即**生成器要服從**別人定的佈局**，**而不是輸出一張通用表格**。**⭐⭐ ③ 作者分工逐條寫明，且每人附 ORCID 與單位**——**`Pavel Belakurski`（Northwestern University）**逐字負責**「**original design and prototype implementation**」**；**`Mark Chumack`（UMass Amherst）**逐字負責**「**HMO / Buy-In enrollment indicator sampler (sticky Markov-chain model)**」**；**`Michael Bouzinier`（Harvard University）**逐字負責**「**packaging, refactor into a Python library, and input data provenance**」**。**⭐⭐ ④ 引用機制可機讀，且指向兩份不同的東西**——`CITATION.cff`（2,943 位元組）**逐字含** `cff-version: 1.2.0`、**「**GitHub renders a "Cite this repository" button in the right sidebar when this file is present at the repo root.**」、**`type: software`**；**README 另給出一條**與程式碼不同的**引用**（**同伴資料集**，**DOI 逐字為** `10.5281/zenodo.18915558`**）**——**⭐ 即**「**引用這個軟體**」與「**引用這份資料**」**是兩個條目、兩個 DOI**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 版本被釘在具體標籤上**（**關聯標識逐字指向** `.../tree/v0.2.0`**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 狀態如實標註**——**逐字開頭為**「**Alpha — functional and exercised end-to-end at production scale**」**（**⭐ 成熟度是 Alpha，**使用程度是生產規模跑過**，**兩者都不等於第三方驗證**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 與池內條目的關係**：**本站 [[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]] 記錄官方去識別化樣本**，**[[gen-syn]]、[[synthpop]]、[[sdv]]、[[ctgan-r]] 覆蓋合成資料生成的不同做法**，**而本條補上的是**「**按官方定寬傳輸規範生成、**維持單一人群跨年一致、**並故意注入具名缺陷**」**；**⭐ 並如實指出**合成資料**不能用來推斷真實的美國醫療費用或人群特徵**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]]、[[gen-syn]] 應當並讀**——**⭐ 其中三點可以直接照抄**：**① 一開始就只維護一個人群；**② 故意注入**具名的缺陷類型**；**③ 把**軟體引用**與**資料引用**分成兩個 DOI**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有安裝該套件、沒有生成任何資料、沒有讀任何 DAT 檔**，**故不主張**其生成器按所述工作、不主張其輸出真的符合 ResDAC FTS 規範。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何原始碼**——**只讀了** `README.md`、`CITATION.cff`、**Zenodo 元數據與檔案清單**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核對 ResDAC FTS 規範本身**（**未訪問 ResDAC 任何頁面**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實同伴資料集 DOI 的內容與版本關係**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實「**生產規模跑過**」這一說法**；**★0 與無外部引用不構成品質證據**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實四位作者與其單位的關係**；**未核實原型倉庫的繼承關係**。**⑦ ⚠️ 許可為 Apache-2.0，未讀正文**；**⭐ 但未見單獨的資料許可聲明**。**⑧ ⚠️ Zenodo 記錄建立 2026-09-07 與倉庫推送 2026-09-10 都在解凍窗口之內**；**⭐ 但「按官方定寬規範生成＋單一人群跨年一致＋故意注入具名缺陷＋軟體與資料分開引用」此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 合成資料不得用於推斷真實醫療費用或人群差異**。
e.body_en:
The project synthetic-resdac-claims, also called synthmed, archived on Zenodo and hosted on GitHub, **is a Python package that generates synthetic Medicare claims data**. **Measured this round**: on the archive side, a version DOI, a concept DOI, **version 0.2.0**, resource type Software, **licence Apache-2.0**, **created and updated on 2026-09-07**, a single file, open access, four creators each carrying an ORCID, keywords naming Medicare, the national data archive, synthetic data, claims and the two claim file families, and one related identifier pointing at a version-tagged GitHub path and marked as supplementing it; on the repository side, **created 2026-05-16**, **last pushed 2026-09-10**, zero stars, Python, with a README of 14,142 bytes, a citation file of 2,943 bytes and a licence file of 11,357 bytes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of evidence and citability.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README, the citation file and the archive metadata**: **first, it maintains a single cohort rolled forward year by year, so consistency across files is designed in rather than fixed afterwards.** Verbatim, the generator maintains a single internal cohort of synthetic beneficiaries and rolls it forward year by year so that demographics, identifiers, locations and diagnosis histories stay consistent across files, and realistic data-quality errors, naming race miscoding, date-of-birth drift and state-correlated null identifiers, are injected on the way through. **When generating multi-year, multi-file synthetic data, the easiest thing to overlook is whether the same person in different years is the same person; the answer here is not post-hoc alignment but starting from one population only.** **What is more notable is that it deliberately adds errors: the point of synthetic data is not to be clean but to be something methods can be tested on, including their error handling, and the three named defect classes are concrete failures that occur in real data.** **Second, it emits according to somebody else specification rather than its own convenience**, describing its output verbatim as fixed-width DAT files conforming to a set of national archive file transfer specification schemas, with keywords naming both claim file families. **The generator must obey a layout defined elsewhere, with fixed widths and fixed field positions, rather than emitting a general-purpose table.** **Third, the division of labour is written out author by author, each with an ORCID and an affiliation**: one author is credited verbatim with the original design and prototype implementation and linked to a prototype repository; a second with the enrolment indicator sampler described as a sticky Markov-chain model; a third by affiliation only; and a fourth verbatim with packaging, the refactor into a Python library and **input data provenance**. **Who did what sits on the front page of the README, and the last author responsibility explicitly includes the provenance of the input data.** **Fourth, the citation mechanism is machine-readable and points at two different things**: the citation file declares format version 1.2.0 and notes verbatim that GitHub renders a cite-this-repository button when the file is present at the repository root; it sets the type to software; and it lists four authors with names, ORCIDs, and for two of them an alias and an affiliation, with a message telling users to cite the software using the metadata below while noting that the companion synthetic dataset is archived on Zenodo at the DOI given under identifiers. The README separately gives a citation for a 2026 dataset release with its own DOI, titled as synthetic Medicare-like inpatient claims and beneficiary data conforming to the archive layouts. **Citing the software and citing the data are therefore two entries with two DOIs.** **Fifth, the archived version is pinned to a specific tag**, since the related identifier points at a version-tagged path rather than a repository home page, so which commit this archive corresponds to is checkable in one step. **Sixth, the status is stated honestly**: the README opens its status section by calling the project alpha while also saying it is functional and exercised end-to-end at production scale, **which states maturity and usage separately, and neither is third-party validation**. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: the pooled official de-identified sample entry records a regulator-released extract, the pooled synthetic data entries cover several generation approaches, and the pooled Medicare coding and pricing entries cover that side of the data, while this entry supplies generation against an official fixed-width transfer specification with a single cohort held consistent across years and named defects injected deliberately, and software and data cited separately. **It is stated plainly that synthetic data must not be used to infer real US medical costs or population characteristics.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]] and [[gen-syn]]**, because **it answers how to build usable data when no real data is available while still knowing where it is dirty**, and three of its practices can be copied directly: maintain one population from the start rather than aligning afterwards, inject named defect classes rather than producing unrealistically clean fake data, and separate the software citation from the data citation into two identifiers.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the package was not installed, no data was generated and no DAT file was read**, **so the generator is not claimed to work as described, its output is not claimed to conform to the archive specification, and the injected defect classes are not claimed to resemble real distributions**. **Second, no source code was read**: only the README, the citation file, the archive metadata and the file listing were read, **so nothing is claimed about the actual implementation of the single-cohort roll-forward, the sticky Markov-chain sampler, or the rates and mechanisms of error injection; this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the archive specification itself was not checked**, no archive page was visited, so the claim of conformance is recorded as the project own statement rather than as a verified fact. **Fourth, the companion dataset DOI given in the README was not opened**, and its relationship to this package version was not established. **Fifth, the claim of being exercised at production scale was not verified** and has neither evidence nor third-party validation here, while zero stars and no recorded external citations are neither evidence of quality nor evidence against it. **Sixth, the four authors and their stated affiliations were not verified beyond the README and the ORCIDs, nor was the code lineage from the prototype repository. Seventh, the licence is Apache-2.0 by both the archive field and the repository licence file, whose text was not read, and no separate data licence statement was seen. Eighth, both the archive record and the repository push fall inside the thaw window, so no window exception is needed; however, the combination of generation against an official fixed-width specification, a single cohort kept consistent across years, deliberately injected named defects, and separate citations for software and data had no counterpart in the pool. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that synthetic data must not be used to infer real medical costs or population differences.**
